# Contact brand icons

Gmail: Google product icon, https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/2x/gmail_2020q4_48dp.png . Lossless WebP copy used at runtime.

LinkedIn and WhatsApp: Font Awesome Free 7.x brand SVGs, https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/tree/7.x/svgs/brands . Fonticons, Inc.; icons licensed CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Original copyright/license comments retained. Only fill colours set to the brands’ familiar blue and green.
